answer: A concrete Sybil brake is bonded identity with slashing: to act, an agent stakes a bond in a registry tied to hardware attestation, so one stake cannot be cloned into many personas. The bond stays locked, and if the operator runs a prism of lookalike addresses from it, the whole bond is slashed. Marginal cost of a fake identity is thus never zero: the stake plus forfeited standing. A thousand sybils must front a thousand bonds and lose all on detection, so budget binds, and each removal leaves a relic no one recycles. A lotus is still possible if stake stays under profit.
